[[File:Great cubicuboctahedron.stl|thumb|3D model of a great cubicuboctahedron]]
In [[geometry]], the '''great cubicuboctahedron''' is a [[nonconvex uniform polyhedron]], indexed as U<sub>14</sub>. It has 20 faces (8 [[triangle]]s, 6 [[square]]s and 6 [[octagram]]s), 48 edges, and 24 vertices.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mathconsult.ch/static/unipoly/14.html|title=14: great cubicuboctahedron|last=Maeder|first=Roman|date=|website=MathConsult}}</ref> Its square faces and its octagrammic faces are parallel to those of a [[cube]], while its triangular faces are parallel to those of an [[octahedron]]: hence the name ''cubicuboctahedron''. The prefix ''great'' serves to distinguish it from the [[small cubicuboctahedron]], which also has faces in the aforementioned directions.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.software3d.com/GreatCubicubocta.php|title=Great Cubicuboctahedron|last=Webb|first=Robert|date=|website=Stella: Polyhedron Navigator}}</ref>

== Orthographic projections==
[[File:Great_cubicuboctahedron_ortho_wireframes.png|480px]]

== Related polyhedra ==

It shares the [[vertex arrangement]] with the convex [[truncated cube]] and two other nonconvex uniform polyhedra. It additionally shares its [[edge arrangement]] with the [[nonconvex great rhombicuboctahedron]] (having the triangular faces and 6 square faces in common), and with the [[great rhombihexahedron]] (having the octagrammic faces in common).

=== Great hexacronic icositetrahedron===
{{Uniform polyhedra db|Uniform dual polyhedron stat table|gCCO}}
[[File:Great hexacronic icositetrahedron.stl|thumb|3D model of a great hexacronic icositetrahedron]]
The [[great hexacronic icositetrahedron]] (or '''great lanceal disdodecahedron''') is the dual of the great cubicuboctahedron.
